0.1 This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the Indian Standards Inltitution on 30 August 1985, after the draft finalized by the Fire Fighting Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Bngineering Division Council. 0.2 A number of Indian Standards on trailer pumps have been formulated and in order to supplement the requirements in respect of the pumping capacity and other necessary fire fighting equipments, towing tenderl are attached with the large trailer pumps specially in rural areas and industrial complexes. This standard has, therefore, been formulated to give functional requirements relating to such towing tenders. This standard was tint published in the year 1960. This revision has been prepared 10 as to bale the appliance according to the available chasis and also up-to-date various requirements besides keeping them in line with similar Indian Standards. While revising this standard the title has been revised al in present form, it will not be possible to cover this in lSI CenificatioD. The technical committee is, however J developing a luitable durability test which may ensure a reasonable life of this appliance. After this teat is developed the same will be incorporated in this Itandard and standard will be made certifiable. 0.3 A list of accessories and equipment which do not form part of this appliance and moat of which are normally required to assist in.operation oCthe appliance is given in Appendix A for information and guidance. The appliaace Ihall also conform to statutory rules, in regard to height clearance framed by transport authority.
